_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::fluid_turbulence#2 and a partial FALSIFICATION. The entry's 'CFL < 1 for explicit' branch is inapplicable: FLUID DYNAMIC TIMEINTEGR offers only Af_Gen_Alpha, BDF2, Np_Gen_Alpha, One_Step_Theta and Stationary, all implicit, and 4C prints that list when an explicit scheme is requested. So 'explicit time integration at CFL > 1 gives NaN within ~10 steps' cannot be observed in 4C. The implicit branch is real: on the upstream channel deck f3_cha_8x8x8_recongradl2 a 100x TIMESTEP runs to the result test with no NaN, no CFL or Courant warning of any kind, and both pinned velocities wrong -- exactly the 'stable but no longer time-accurate' behaviour, with no diagnostic to catch it. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf).

_mutation.note: remove the pathology from the enum arm: ask for an integrator that exists. The rejection and the possible-values list vanish, so the fixture must go red.
remove the pathology from the time-step arm: keep the upstream step. BIGDT_RESULT_FAILURES drops to 0, so the fixture must go red.
